answer: Each identity must publish a public plume tracing its actions this epoch and lock a 25.000 POA copper bond behind it. Peers grade the plume against the ledger; standing rises and falls with the tide of grades. A plume contradicting ledger facts triggers enforcement: the bond is seized, half burned, half paid to the reporter, and the identity is banned 12 epochs. Forging 1.000 fakes means 1.000 plumes and 25.000.000 POA at risk, while an honest agent posts one true plume and pays 25.000 once. Limitation: honest agents doing private off-ledger work leave thin plumes and look suspicious.
